summary_en: This study tests subcutaneous talquetamab, alone and later with daratumumab, in older adults with multiple myeloma that returned early after treatment. Talquetamab is given under the skin, starting with three step-up doses, then 800 μg/kg every other week in 28-day cycles, and daratumumab is added in part 2 for some patients. The record does not state the main outcome measure; it is a Phase 2 single-arm study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa talquetamab subcutáneo, solo y después junto con daratumumab, en adultos mayores con mieloma múltiple que recayó poco tiempo después del tratamiento. El talquetamab se administra debajo de la piel, comenzando con tres dosis de aumento gradual y luego 800 μg/kg cada dos semanas, en ciclos de 28 días, y el daratumumab se agrega en la parte 2 para algunos pacientes. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; es un estudio de fase 2 de un solo brazo.
who_for: Adults aged 70 years or older (no upper age limit stated).
Multiple myeloma that is relapsed or refractory after at least 2 prior lines of therapy.
Prior treatment must have included a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory drug.
Measurable disease by M-protein or free light chain levels.
Part 2 is limited to patients who are not refractory to an anti-CD38 antibody.
not_for: Gene-modified cell therapy such as CAR T within 3 months.
Prior allogeneic transplant, or autologous transplant within 12 weeks.
Known active brain or meningeal myeloma, or plasma cell leukemia, Waldenström macroglobulinemia, POEMS syndrome, or primary amyloid light chain amyloidosis.
